basic_details.job_title: PAU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.post_name: Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) has published the Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow Notification 2026 on its official website, https://www.pau.edu. The recruitment drive aims to fill 2 positions under this project. Candidates possessing an M.Sc. in Agriculture, Biotechnology, or Biosciences with the required academic qualifications and national-level eligibility test qualifications (or a Ph.D. as applicable) are eligible to apply. The offline application process will remain open up to 10 August 2026, and shortlisted candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 14 August 2026

qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. in Agriculture/ Biotechnology/ Biosciences with minimum OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks & at least two years of post M.Sc Research/ Teaching experience. Ph.D in the discipline required at Master's level is also eligible. Must have passed GATE/CSIR-UGC_NET/ARS-NET/DBT-BET or equivalent national level test (Ph.D candidates exempted).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for PAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.pau.edu. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow positions at Punjab Agricultural University is 10th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by Punjab Agricultural University for the posts of Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Agriculture/ Biotechnology/ Biosciences with a minimum OCPA of 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks, along with at least two years of post-M.Sc. research or teaching experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of Rs. 200/- is required, which should be paid through online payment in favor of Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for Research Associate and Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The salary for Research Associate is Rs. 47,000/- + 16% HRA, and for Junior Research Fellow, it is Rs 37,000/- + 16% HRA (Rs. 30,000+16% HRA for non-NET candidates).

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for PAU Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Does PAU offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any such information.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit attested copies of their certificates, photograph, signature, and ID proof along with the filled application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, www.pau.edu.
